newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa turns lower, coffee mixed, sugar slips.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa turns lower, coffee mixed, sugar slips.

text.p: COCOA - Turns lower. May/July switches active before Thursday's first notice day. May down 16 at 1,006 at 1428 GMT.
COFFEE - Mixed. May still down ahead of first tender day while rest mostly flat to higher. July up $5 at $1,605.
SUGAR - Outright trade sales coupled with light AA interest keeps Aug at lows. Watches NY ahead of May expiry. Aug off 40 cents at $312.70.
